Name: Cane
Purpose: Used as the main walking assist for Parkinson patients and will hold the main project

Name: ESP32 Board
Purpose: "The main system (MCU) ""The Brain Of the Game"""

Name: MPU 6050 IMU Sensor
Purpose: To sense the change in the patient's body vibrations and orientations detecting (FoG) or fall

Name: Beam Laser Emitter
Purpose: Provides a visual cue for the patient to overcome the FoG state

Name: Passive Buzzer
Purpose: Provides sound cue for the patient to overcome the FoG state

Name: MT3608 Step up Converter
Purpose: Converts the battery voltage to the operating voltage of the laser (12VDC)

Name: TP4056 TYPE-C
Purpose: A battery charging board module to enable charging the system's battry

Name: 1 Cell 18650 Battery Holder
Purpose: Holds the battery in place (on the PCB)
